commitments.detail: Move the hive from the patio stand to the far east fence, at least 50 feet from the patio, and install a screened barrier to protect the neighbor with the severe bee allergy.
Introduce a new queen to the hive by May 15th, with Ravi assisting on the queen introduction and conducting follow-up inspections to track colony recovery.
No honey harvesting before June 1st at the earliest, to allow the colony time to recover after queen introduction.

Plan to deliver twelve jars of honey to the Willow Street Hospice fundraiser by August 20th, 2026, contingent on the hive recovering sufficiently. Provide Celeste with an honest assessment of production likelihood as the season progresses so she can arrange alternatives if needed.
If hive recovery is insufficient by mid-summer, Celeste will contact the hospice fundraiser to adjust or find an alternative for the twelve-jar commitment.
